req.title: Retrieve player by ID
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /players/{playerId} with the corresponding player object.

doc.reasoning: The requirement covers GET /players/{playerId} returning HTTP 200 with a matching Player object. Tests must cover: (1) positive EP — known UUID returns 200 + exact player fields; (2) negative NEG — unknown UUID returns 404; (3) boundary BVA — malformed/non-UUID path segment returns 422 (FastAPI path validation); (4) additional positive EP — verify all response fields exactly match seeded data to catch field-mapping mutations; (5) DT — two distinct valid UUIDs to confirm routing is not hard-coded. All tests use in-process TestClient, exact-value assertions, and seeded fixture data only.

tests.name: test_get_player_by_id_known_uuid_returns_200_and_exact_fields
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 seeded players
expected: Response body matches all fields of the seeded player exactly
trace: R-PLAYER-002: system shall respond with matching Player object on GET /players/{playerId}
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_id_known_uuid_returns_200_and_exact_fields():
    r = client.get('/players/97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802'
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Anjali'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Banerjee'
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 1
    assert body['position'] == 'Defensive Midfield'
    assert body['abbrPosition'] == 'GK'
    assert body['team'] == 'Manchester City'
    assert body['league'] == 'Serie A'
    assert body['starting11'] == False
    assert body['dateOfBirth'] == '1901-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'

tests.name: test_get_player_by_id_empty_string_segment_returns_4xx
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 seeded players
actions: Send GET /players/ (empty playerId segment — routes to list endpoint, not by-id)
expected: HTTP 200 from list endpoint OR HTTP 404/405 — must NOT return a single player object for an empty id
trace: R-PLAYER-002: NEG — empty path segment should not match /players/{playerId} as a valid UUID
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_id_empty_string_segment_returns_4xx():
    # /players/ routes to the list endpoint, not the by-id endpoint
    r = client.get('/players/')
    # Must be 200 (list) — NOT a single-player object keyed by empty string
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    # The list endpoint returns an array, not a single object
    assert isinstance(body, list)
